BiblicalUsage: Azariah was one of Daniel's three companions, carried into Babylon and given the name Abednego. He went with Daniel to ask the king for time, and he stood with his friends before the golden image and before the furnace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Azariah's faith is the kind I want: he prayed with his friends first, and then he stood — and the fire could not burn what prayer had already given to God.
